latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Plan Executive Recruiting Boutique Local SEO FAQ Cluster.

- Provides a workflow to research, cluster, and draft local SEO-focused FAQ copy for executive recruiting firms.
- Includes guidance for clarifying audience and business goals, creating strong first drafts, and refining outputs.
- Offers built-in support for SEO keyword targeting and local search intent.
- Utilizes web search and chat capabilities for research and content creation.
- Recommends human review to ensure unbiased employment content.
